summary.en: A terminal as an object: a title bar, a command typed behind a block caret, output lines printed one by one whose spinners settle into ticks, and a last line in the accent.
summary.zh: 当成实物的终端窗：标题栏、块状光标后敲进的命令、逐行打出的输出（转圈落成对勾），以及一行强调色的结尾。

fits: Scenes that show a command-line tool working: a command, its output, what it made.
notFor: Long logs or code to be read; graphical apps; more than four output lines.

intent.en: A command-line tool shown working as a real object: a command typed, output that settles line by line, and a last line that says it is done.
intent.zh: 把命令行工具当实物来展示它在干活：敲进一条命令，输出一行行落定，最后一行告诉你完成了。

content.en: A window name and path, one command (≤ 22 chars), 2–4 output lines (key, value, note; value ≤ 9 Chinese characters), an optional progress count and a ready line.
content.zh: 窗口名和路径，一条命令（≤ 22 字符），2–4 行输出（键、值、备注；值中文 ≤ 9 字），可选进度计数和一行完成标记。

fits.zh: 展示命令行工具工作的场景：一条命令、它的输出、它产出了什么。

notFor.zh: 要读的长日志或代码；图形界面应用；多于四行输出。

pairs.note: three windows as stations in space

en: Keep the command short and the output to 2–4 lines; more becomes unreadable texture.
The caret sits right after the last typed character; it blinks only while idle.
zh: 命令要短、输出 2–4 行；再多成了看不清的质感。
光标紧贴已打出的最后一个字；只在待机时闪。

upstream.name: 终端空间飞行
upstream.summary: 三个终端窗散布 3D 空间，相机窗间飞行、途中正弦拉远，每到一窗打字机敲命令、结果逐行滑出——命令执行的空间叙事流
upstream.use: 开发者产品的 CLI/工作流演示：把"三步命令"拍成三站空间旅程
upstream.energy: 中（飞行给动感、打字给节奏，整体是沉稳的技术叙事；收在 ● READY 一记亮点）

overlaps.note: input-field is one field typed into; terminal-window is a whole window with a prompt, output lines and a last line

waive.all: a prop has no upstream shot of its own: its typing, printing and last line are measured inside terminal-stations, whose compare against terminal-3d passes (deviation 0 px, events ±0)
